info.title: E-commerce
info.description: The customer's order and the process around it. OrderSaga reacts to the checkout, the payment and the shipment, and sends the next command. The order decides when it is confirmed, completed or canceled.

in-memory.description: The message bus inside the application. Each channel delivers a message to the queues bound to it with a matching routing key, as a RabbitMQ topic exchange does.

kafka.description: Apache Kafka, with messaging.bus=kafka. Each channel is a topic. A queue is a consumer group.

rabbitmq.description: RabbitMQ, with messaging.bus=rabbitmq. Each channel is a topic exchange. A queue is a quorum queue bound to it with a routing key pattern.

HeadersNotDocumented.title: HeadersNotDocumented
HeadersNotDocumented.description: There can be headers, but they are not explicitly documented.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: CloseUnpaidOrder
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Closes an order that is still unpaid at its due date. An order that was not sent is canceled. An order that was sent is closed as unpaid.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: PlaceOrder
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Places an order for the products of a checked-out shopping cart, at the prices of the checkout.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: RecordOrderPackageSent
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Records that the package left the warehouse, with the carrier and the tracking number.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: RecordOrderPaymentAuthorization
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Records that the order's payment is authorized. The customer is not charged yet.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: RecordOrderPaymentCapture
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Records that the customer was charged for the order.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: RecordOrderPaymentFailure
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Records that the order's payment failed.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: RecordOrderShipmentFailure
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Records that the order's products cannot ship, and why.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: RecordOrderStockReservation
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Records that the warehouse set aside the order's products.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: AuthorizePayment
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Asks for a payment of the amount. The payment waits until the customer authorizes it on the payment provider's page.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: CancelPayment
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Cancels an authorized payment before the customer is charged.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: CapturePayment
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Asks to charge the customer the authorized amount.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: PaymentAuthorized
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: The payment is authorized: the payment provider keeps the amount for the requester. The customer is not charged yet.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: PaymentCaptured
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: The customer was charged.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: PaymentFailed
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: The payment failed: the customer did not authorize it in time, the authorization ran out, or charging the customer failed.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: ReleaseStock
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Puts the products that are set aside back on sale.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: RequestFulfillment
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Asks the fulfillment service to pick, pack and send the products that are set aside.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: ReserveStock
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: Asks the warehouse to set aside the products, so that nobody else can buy them.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: PackageWasSent
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: The package left the warehouse. It carries the carrier and the tracking number.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: ShipmentFailed
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: The products cannot ship. The reason tells if they are out of stock or the fulfillment service rejected the request.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: StockReserved
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: The warehouse set aside the products for the requester.

io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.title: ShoppingCartCheckedOut
io.eventdriven.distributedprocesses.ecom.description: The customer checked out the shopping cart. It carries the customer, the products, their prices and the total.

orders-internal_receive_closeUnpaidOrder.title: orders-internal_receive
orders-internal_receive_closeUnpaidOrder.description: Closes the order if it is still unpaid at its due date.

orders-internal_receive_recordOrderPacka.title: orders-internal_receive
orders-internal_receive_recordOrderPacka.description: Records that the package was sent. Then the shop charges the customer.

orders-internal_receive_recordOrderPayme.title: orders-internal_receive
orders-internal_receive_recordOrderPayme.description: Records that the payment is authorized. If the products are set aside too, the order is confirmed.

orders-internal_receive_recordOrderPayme.title: orders-internal_receive
orders-internal_receive_recordOrderPayme.description: Records that the customer was charged. If the package was sent, the order is completed.

orders-internal_receive_recordOrderPayme.title: orders-internal_receive
orders-internal_receive_recordOrderPayme.description: Records that the payment failed. The order waits for the customer to pay again, until its due date.

orders-internal_receive_recordOrderShipm.title: orders-internal_receive
orders-internal_receive_recordOrderShipm.description: Records that the products cannot ship. The order is canceled when the payment has answered.

orders-internal_receive_recordOrderStock.title: orders-internal_receive
orders-internal_receive_recordOrderStock.description: Records that the products are set aside. If the payment is authorized too, the order is confirmed.

orders-internal_send_onPackageWasSent.title: orders-internal_send
orders-internal_send_onPackageWasSent.description: Records on the order that the package was sent.

orders-internal_send_onPaymentAuthorized.title: orders-internal_send

orders-internal_send_onPaymentCaptured.title: orders-internal_send
orders-internal_send_onPaymentCaptured.description: Records on the order that the customer was charged.

orders-internal_send_onPaymentFailed.title: orders-internal_send
orders-internal_send_onPaymentFailed.description: Records on the order that the payment failed.

orders-internal_send_onShipmentFailed.title: orders-internal_send
orders-internal_send_onShipmentFailed.description: Records on the order that the products cannot ship.

orders-internal_send_onShoppingCartCheck.title: orders-internal_send
orders-internal_send_onShoppingCartCheck.description: Places an order for the checked-out shopping cart.

orders-internal_send_onStockReserved.title: orders-internal_send
orders-internal_send_onStockReserved.description: Records on the order that the products are set aside.

orders-payments-responses_receive_onPaym.title: orders-payments-responses_receive
orders-payments-responses_receive_onPaym.description: Passes the authorized payment on to the order.

orders-payments-responses_receive_onPaym.title: orders-payments-responses_receive
orders-payments-responses_receive_onPaym.description: Passes the charge on to the order.

orders-payments-responses_receive_onPaym.title: orders-payments-responses_receive
orders-payments-responses_receive_onPaym.description: Passes the failed payment on to the order.

orders-shipments-responses_receive_onPac.title: orders-shipments-responses_receive
orders-shipments-responses_receive_onPac.description: Passes the sent package on to the order.

orders-shipments-responses_receive_onShi.title: orders-shipments-responses_receive
orders-shipments-responses_receive_onShi.description: Passes the failed shipment on to the order.

orders-shipments-responses_receive_onSto.title: orders-shipments-responses_receive

orders-shopping_carts-external_receive_o.title: orders-shopping_carts-external_receive

payments-requests_send_onOrderCanceled.title: payments-requests_send
payments-requests_send_onOrderCanceled.description: Cancels the authorized payment when the order is canceled.

payments-requests_send_onOrderPaymentDue.title: payments-requests_send
payments-requests_send_onOrderPaymentDue.description: Asks to charge the customer when the package was sent.

payments-requests_send_onOrderPaymentRet.title: payments-requests_send
payments-requests_send_onOrderPaymentRet.description: Asks for the order's payment when the order is placed, and again when the customer retries a failed payment.

payments-requests_send_onOrderPlaced.title: payments-requests_send
payments-requests_send_onOrderPlaced.description: Asks for the order's payment when the order is placed, and again when the customer retries a failed payment.

shipments-requests_send_onOrderCanceled.title: shipments-requests_send
shipments-requests_send_onOrderCanceled.description: Puts the products back on sale when the order is canceled.

shipments-requests_send_onOrderConfirmed.title: shipments-requests_send
shipments-requests_send_onOrderConfirmed.description: Asks the warehouse to send the products when the order is confirmed.

shipments-requests_send_onOrderPlaced.title: shipments-requests_send
shipments-requests_send_onOrderPlaced.description: Asks the warehouse to set aside the order's products when the order is placed.
